items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: So Buddy Rich followed me on that band.

ctx.x: That's really a pain in the buns, isn't it?
I tell you. I was in the hospital, they took me back to Maine, and Artie Shaw couldn't wait until I got well, so he gave Buddy Rich a contract.
Is that how that dude got in there?
